items.title: Glenfiddich and Aston Martin Just Dropped Two New Whiskies at the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
items.why: Glenfiddich and Aston Martin released two new whiskies aged 16 and 28 years, timed to the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.
